title: Bizunker
description: Bizunker adds a new mobs, biomes, trees, recipes, blocks and more! The mod is currently still in development, these are just the first few things to be added.
body:
Bizunker adds a new mobs, biomes, trees, recipes, blocks and more!

The mod is currently still in development, these are just the first few things to be added.

This is also my first mod!

ALL NEW FEATURES:

Bombang - A non-hostile mob that can be ignited to explode, drops fuse upon death. Makes creeper sounds to scare you, but harmless.

Fuse - A new drop that can be used to make bombs, drops from the bombang.

Bizunker - New creative tab for (most) new features

Pomegranate Tree - New tree that has custom leaves/logs. Logs cannot be crafted into anything as of now, but that will change. Leaves have a chance of dropping pomegranates when broken.

Pomegranate - Fruit that can be eaten to result in...

Halved Pomegranate - Nourishes and gives you much more hunger points that a whole pomegranate. You get it by eating pomegranate.

Pomegranate Husk - You get this by eating a halved pomegranate. Can be used to craft a bomb.

Bomb - A block crafted with pomegranate husk, gunpowder and fuse. Can be used as TNT, but doesn't destroy blocks, only does damage.

Primed Bomb - Entity form of the bomb.

Orchard - New biome which contains pomegranate trees and a new structure.

Rock Pit - Small structure which spawns with a new block, and spawns in many biomes but most notably, the orchard.

Shattered Rock - A new block that spawns in rock pits. It drops itself and can be used decoratively. Can be smelted.

Rocky Shards - Obtained by smelting Shattered Rocks, can be used to craft.

Rough Dagger - Crafted using a stick and rocky shards, does descent damage and has good DPS. First of many new tools.

**WIKI PAGE UPCOMING SO I DONT HAVE TO PUT ALL FEATURES HERE

THIS IS ALREADY OUTDATED (THE ABOVE LIST OF FEATURES)**

Currently only released on Legacy Curseforge, Curseforge, Modrinth and MCreator.

LOG:

v1.0.0 - Release

v1.1.0 - Nebu update! Nebu is a new rare mineral which can be found very close to bedrock. You can now get raw nebu, nebu ingots, raw/refined nebu blocks, ore, armour and a brand new nebu sword with a custom texture! 

v1.2.0 -  v1.2 is out! Brand new magnesium ore, a common ore that can spawn on the surface. It can be crafted into ingots and blocks, but it can also be crafted with iron to produce Olivine, a new mineral. Olivine can be crafted into blocks, or crafted with lava to produce Skuz, a liquid which's gimmick is the ability to pull you towards the main block.

Pomegranate wood type is FINALLY here. Wood, planks, stairs, fences, doors, trapdoors, boats and more, it is finally fleshed out! Orchard is now playable.

Lastly, there is now a new pickaxe, the Nebu Pickaxe! It is pretty good although both the sword and the pickaxe will hopefully recieve better balancing/gimmicks in the future.

v1.3.0  - 

v1.3.0 - SUPER random update. New workbench block, the desalinator! Craft it with restone dust, magnesium ingots and iron ingots, and then simply input both a water and lava bucket, and get back salt and 2 iron buckets in return! Salt can be crafted with any cooked meat to produce either salted meat, or salted fish, both of with have slightly buffed saturation and health increase than their unsalted counterparts.

A new nether biome, called the Sheol Plains, has been added, sporting new structures, blocks and eerie fog.

And finally, gunpowder packets, (crafted using gunpowder and paper) and hand canons (crafting using pomegranate, planks and sticks) have been added, allowing you to launch a deadly, powerful attack towards any enemies and span a large area with a projectile, without destroying or setting alight any blocks! It is pure damage.

I had a lot of fun with this update and I hope you guys do to!

Also, there is now an experimental mob called the 'Kajumba'. You can obtain its spawn egg via commands or the creative inventory, and right now it is bugged which is why it hasn't been implemented into survival yet.
